div.head: Northu 63.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif hi on ðam geéndigan buton geswicennesse, þolian clænes legeres ⁊ Godes mildse.
And gif hi on ðam geendigan buton geswicennesse, þolian clænes legeres and Godes mildse.
Und wenn sie in dem [Sündigen] enden ohne Abstehen [davon], sollen sie ehrliches Grab und Gottes Gnade verlieren.
And if they end [their lives] in that [sin] without ceasing [from it], let them lose burial in consecrated ground and God's mercy.
And if they die in that [sin] without desisting from it, they are to forfeit Christian burial and God's mercy.
And if they die without putting an end to that, let them be deprived of Christian burial and God's mercy.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
